Authentic Fresh Seafood!!
Apr 2017 • Couples
My wife and I visited for dinner while staying at the Amiana Resort. We almost didn't go in because on the ground floor the restaurant looks a bit dodgy but, the restaurant seating is on the two upper floors and looks much better. Customers are invited to choose fresh fish from the tanks on the ground floor and then it's fried or steamed with a choice of flavourings.

There is a wide variety of seafood on offer and we chose Crab, Scallops & Mantis Shrimp (by mistake thinking they were ordinary shrimps.

The food was tasty and well cooked and we found an English speaking waiter which also helped a great deal. 

This is an authentic Vietnamese seafood restaurant and although the menu is in English and Russian, we were the only foreigners and, made to fell very welcome.

MY TIP - the fresh fish is priced in kilos but don't be afraid to order half kilos if you want variety.

Don't waste your appetite and time here
Dec 2016 • Family
This probably made me never wanna come back to Vietnam ever again.

We were mugged by taxi driver there first. 46,000vnd by meter I gave him 50,000he refused to take , asking for 5 usd. I yelled at him, in the end he took 3 usd.

Back to the restaurant okay. 
1. Super over priced. Coming from Hong Kong, the top 3 most expensive city in the world. I tell you seafood in Hong Kong is cheaper than this place. 

2. Early dinner. 3 of us ordered 5 dishes in the first place. And a big bowl of rice. We felt not enough after finishing everything . 

And just 3 hrs ago, we had pizza for lunch. 

3. Ordered the 6th dish as we didn't wanna go back to the hotel feeling hungry. 30 mins later , the waitress told us our orders were all served. Then she crossed away the unserved ones on the list. I told her there is one dish not here yet, in English , and in Chinese both she didn't understand . Then she went to the garbage to take back the clam shells we disposed to show me what is what. In the end, the manager came, confirmed the 6th dish wasn't served. 

Alright , it came as a plate of fried clams, half empty half dead(closed). 

4. It was a 725,000vnd bill. I asked if they accepte usd. The waitress says yes. But 1usd=20,000vnd. I also understand it's my bad that I didn't have enough vnd, so I will have to lose a bit more money to the currency exchange at restaurants. Then the waitress told me it's 50usd for 725,000 vnd. I took my iPhone calculator, showed her it's 36.25 usd. She refused to believe me, did the calculation twice with her own phone. 
Can't believe Asians do such bad math in this country. 

5. Food very average I didn't even want to take photos. 

6. Bad experience. it's not the money I regret. It's these unpleasant experiences ruined our appetite and vacation mood. 

Never come back

Never again!
Jul 2015 • Family
We went there based on the recommendation of the concierge at our hotel and after reading the positive reviews from TA. What a mistake!

Service was very bad, but I didn't have high expectation. The restaurant has water everywhere on the floor, table cloth was dirty. There were not enough fans, and it was so hot that I felt like in a steam room

The food was a huge disappointment. The jellyfish salad was ok although we have had it better at other places such as Nha Trang Seafood. Veggies were ok, couldn't go wrong with that. Grilled shrimps were good as they were live shrimps. Tamarind sauce crabs were overcooked and little too sweet. Hotpot with Grouper was a huge miss! After waiting for a long long time, the waitress brought out a pot of cold soup which tasted like clear water mixed with sour powder. The poor dead fish was left waiting until the soup boiling. Even with everything put in to pot, fish and veggies, the soup was tasteless.

I have been in Nha Trang countless times, and have never been this disappointed with food. Would definitely neither recommend to anyone nor come back.

This restaurant has 2 branches
Jul 2015 • Friends
The location we visited was close to the river, not exactly where TripAdvisor puts it on the map. We spent a week in Nha Trang and tried out several local restaurants with some local friends. This was the worst of all.
Dirty floors, dirty staircases, inattentive service, even when you are used to the somewhat lower standards in Vietnam.
The food was bad, borderline unedible. We had 7 dishes for 6 people, none of them we would ever think of ordering again.
Just a few examples:

Crab in tamarind souce: the souce was far too sweet and completely overpowering the taste of the crab. The crab was completely overcooked (overfried) and dried out.

The mushroom dish was pretty tasteless, the mushrooms where not cleaned properly. The presentation was horrific, just some almost white pieces in an almost white souce with no spices, no herbs, no decoration.

The jellyfish salad had big pieces of jellyfish, very chewy and not cleaned properly with some pretty tasteless salad.

The fish hotpot consisted of some water with some soup cube which was almost tasteless with some veggies and fish. The fish was fresh.

This was by far the worst place of any we tried in Nha Trang. For western standards the place is cheap, but compared to other places in Nha Trang and for what you get we found it grossly overpriced.
